snippet.title: MSX (emulated) - MSX Copycat by BCO - (BASIC)
snippet.description:
NOTE: If you'd like, you can download 'MSX Copycat' from this page:
https://fourseasons.itch.io/msx-copycat-for-msx-computer

MSX Copycat is an adaptation of the classic memory game SIMON, originally created by Ralph Baer and Howard J. Morrison and distributed in 1978 by Milton Bradley (MB).

This game was developed by Alberto (BCO) Sgaggero as part of the Simon Game BASIC Programming Challenge (8Bit/16Bit), promoted by the Facebook group Retro Programmers Inside (RPI).

Thanks for watching my videos! Have a good day! :)
